description: Source code for storage management in a Bluetooth Mesh lighting application, including functions for saving device states and settings to persistent storage.

methods.name: save_reset_counter
methods.description: Saves the reset counter to persistent storage.

methods.name: save_gen_def_trans_time_state
methods.description: Saves the generic default transition time state.

methods.name: save_gen_onpowerup_state
methods.description: Saves the power-up state and conditionally saves last target states to flash.

methods.name: save_def_states
methods.description: Saves default states for light, temperature, and DUV.

methods.name: save_last_target_states
methods.description: Saves target states for lightness, temperature, and DUV.

methods.name: storage_work_handler
methods.description: Handles storage work based on the current storage ID.

methods.name: save_on_flash
methods.description: Sets the storage ID and submits storage work to save data.

methods.name: ps_set
methods.description: Reads and sets configuration parameters from persistent storage.

methods.name: ps_settings_init
methods.description: Initializes the settings subsystem and registers the settings handler.
